facts.fact: ITWeb reports that the Department of Health advertised a tender on the National Treasury eTenders Portal to appoint a service provider for hosting, maintenance, support and enhancement of the District Health Information System, which the department describes as an integrated aggregated service delivery information system used at facility, district, province and national levels for performance monitoring and statutory reporting.

systems.tiers: facility, district, province and national levels

note: The tender notice says DHIS is used at facility level but does not name facility types or say where the data is keyed, so no tiers or digitised fact is recorded; no contract value or funding source is given.
